claims: Carlos Ulberg is the UFC Light Heavyweight Champion.
Carlos Ulberg defeated Jiří Procházka via first-round knockout.
Carlos Ulberg won the vacant UFC Light Heavyweight title.
Carlos Ulberg has a record of 14-1.
The method of victory was KO (Left Hook).
The knockout occurred at 3:45 of Round 1.
Carlos Ulberg is an active champion.
Carlos Ulberg is a first-time champion.
Carlos Ulberg suffered a knee injury earlier in the first round of the main event at UFC 327.
